The '''Sprinter''' was a [[Hoverbike/Legends|hoverbike]] model produced by [[Rark (company)|Rark]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
